release_contents:
Phase 2 Increment 1 — bilingual content model, silent DB groundwork (2026-09-25, commits 81cfa54/8078f74, superseding 64a4da3). 12 new additive migrations (one nullable `<field>_en` sibling column per translatable field, across activities/activity_types/job_postings/notices/committees/about_page/objectives/content_blocks/organizational_units/organizational_positions/membership_types/committee_positions); all Eloquent $fillable arrays + 2 new CommitteeMember methods; all 7 touched public API controllers (Activity, JobPosting, Notice, Committee, Settings/about, MembershipType, OrganizationUnit) now expose the `_en` keys; NoticeRecruitmentLinker::copyFrom() now mirrors title_en/summary_en/body_en too; all 12 admin CRUD controllers + Blade forms gained matching nullable validation + stacked bn-then-en inputs. Zero visible change on either site by design — every new API key present but null for all existing records. Verified live in production post-deploy: /api/v1/about, /api/v1/membership-types, /api/v1/organization-units all show existing bn values byte-for-byte unchanged with new `_en` keys present-and-null. sahittopata.provatferi.org (flagged second API consumer) and provatferi.org (institutional, still on its pre-Increment-1 build) both re-checked 200 immediately after switch — additive unknown JSON keys confirmed harmless to both real consumers. Full local suite: 460 passed (was 439 before this increment). This deploy also fixed a genuine bug in this very file: an unescaped literal newline inside `release_contents` made it invalid JSON, silently defeating build-release.sh's own previous_commit lookup (fell back to "none") — fixed as commit 8078f74 before building.

Earlier release (2026-09-24, commits 5dcf447/c8e7603/64a4da3): Production mail incident remediation + password show/hide toggle + deploy-pipeline fix, superseding commits 5dcf447/c8e7603. NEW in this release: found live, right after deploying c8e7603, that public/js/ was never in build-release.sh's packaging list or release-manager.php's switch-time docroot sync — the new provatferi-password-toggle.js 404'd in production despite passing every build check (the one pre-existing file there, provatferi-theme.js, only ever worked because it was manually placed on the server once, outside this pipeline, during initial setup). Fixed structurally: public/js/ is now packaged and synced the same way public/brand/ already is; asset-contract.php checks both known js files by name; a new PublicJsAssetContractTest asserts every asset('js/...') reference has a real file AND that both pipeline files still contain the fix. Verified end-to-end THROUGH the real pipeline this deploy (not the manual one-off upload used to unblock production immediately after finding the bug): both js files served 200 with correct byte sizes after this release's own switch. release-manager.php was re-installed to the server (_tooling/) before this deploy's own stage step ran.

Earlier in this release (commits 5dcf447/c8e7603): (1) MAIL: MX had regressed to a single 'smtp.google.com' record (no functioning Google Workspace mailbox behind it), causing bounces/spam placement/silently-failed password-reset delivery despite Laravel reporting success. Restored via the Cloudflare API to the state docs/MAIL_ROLES.md already documented as correct and previously-verified: MX 5/10 mx1/mx2.hostinger.com, SPF Hostinger-only (v=spf1 include:_spf.mail.hostinger.com ~all). DKIM/DMARC/autoconfig/autodiscover were already correct, untouched. Full pre-change DNS snapshot: docs/dns-backups/provatferi-org-2026-09-24-pre-mail-fix.json. Verified propagated on both Cloudflare authoritative nameservers and 8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1. Verified end-to-end against production with a disposable external mailbox: forgot-password -> real SMTP send -> real inbox received the email (~9s) -> reset link opened -> token validated -> new password set -> old password rejected -> new password logged in -> reused token rejected without changing the password. (2) AUTH: a proper eye-icon password show/hide toggle (inline SVG, not an icon font or emoji) on every password field app-wide -- login, reset-password (both fields), confirm-password, profile change-password (all three fields), delete-account confirmation, and the admin user-creation form via <x-admin.form-input type="password">. Default hidden, type="button", Bengali+English aria-label/title, no password value ever read/logged/persisted by the toggle script. New regression tests (PasswordToggleMarkupTest) assert accessible markup and default-hidden state on every page. Full suite green (433/433).
mail_dns_fix: Cloudflare zone 9d06e29d9167b04903e270ff11b0f2f3 (provatferi.org). Changed: MX record repointed from smtp.google.com (priority 1) to mx1.hostinger.com (priority 5); new MX record added for mx2.hostinger.com (priority 10); SPF TXT changed from 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:_spf.mail.hostinger.com ~all' to 'v=spf1 include:_spf.mail.hostinger.com ~all'. Untouched: DKIM (hostingermail-a/b/c CNAMEs), DMARC (p=none, already had a rua= reporting address), autoconfig/autodiscover CNAMEs, google-site-verification TXT, all website A/CNAME records. This was a DNS-only mail-routing fix -- no website/CDN/routing change.
migrations_applied: 12 — all 2026_09_25_060001..060012 (Phase 2 Increment 1 bilingual `_en` columns), applied via migrate-apply after migrate-check's pretend_output was reviewed and confirmed purely additive (every statement an `alter table ... add ... null after ...`). All 12 reported DONE, fastest 10.93ms / slowest 286.61ms.

pending_followups: Phases 8-19 of the 2026-09-24 mail-incident master priority (Admin Mail Center via the Hostinger Mail API, RBAC for mail, webhooks, unified notification center, near-real-time delivery, notification sound) are NOT started — no MCP tool in this environment exposes Hostinger Email/mailbox management (create/list/read/send), so the official-API requirement from that priority cannot be met without either that capability being added or the user providing direct IMAP/SMTP app-password credentials for a dedicated mail-integration mailbox. Tracked separately in this session's own report, not repeated here.
cron_timing_note: Cron runs in UTC; server Date header matched the local UTC clock. One-shot crons scheduled 5-8 minutes ahead on specific minutes, read once, then deleted immediately — never left armed. Two real multi-hour wall-clock jumps occurred during this deploy's waits (10:33->12:01 and 12:16->19:04 UTC) — not errors, just elapsed real time during a long session.
release_manager_path_reminder: release-manager.php lives at the PRIVATE path /home/u951246149/domains/provatferi.org/laravel-admin-releases/_tooling/release-manager.php for every step after the one-time install — NOT under public_html/admin/. Release ids use the SERVER's own format (sha-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-ish, confirmed via that release's manifest.json under _release_staging/), not the local build folder's timezone-local timestamp.
never_fetch_a_staged_script_url: Requesting a staged one-shot script's URL EXECUTES it (it is under the web-servable docroot). Verify removal with the file listing tool instead.
local_mariadb_note: The local dev build machine's MariaDB (XAMPP) was found stopped partway through this deploy, causing one build-release.sh run to hang indefinitely (not fail fast) waiting on a DB connection rather than erroring — the two php.exe worker processes showed real but very slow memory growth, which read as 'still working' until a longer observation window showed it was actually stalled. Fixed by starting D:\ISDB-BISEW\xampp\mysql_start.bat and killing the orphaned php.exe processes before rebuilding. Future sessions: confirm mysqld.exe is running before trusting a long-silent build-release.sh run.
